capabilities.summary: Describe the product-filtered connector catalog. Native catalogFor intersects installed connectors, connected credentials, device capabilities and caller scopes; discovery never replaces per-action authorization.

mcp.registry.describe.mapping: Integration capability alias, not a claimed native HTTP endpoint; caller identity, scopes and catalog inputs must come from the product adapter.

manef:boundaries: Use @cg/gateway/edge for one shared edge implementation. All @cg packages are private source workspaces, not independently published packages.
Gateway policy and device allowlists do not provide an OS sandbox. Persistent outbound relay needs a suitable host.
No registry description implies paired devices, upstream account access, authorization or successful execution.

manef:runtime-notes.gatewayEdge: Web Request/Response and WebCrypto; documented Bun and Node22 compatibility
manef:runtime-notes.existingDrift: Root Dockerfile Bun1.3.14 builder is below package requirement Bun>=1.4.2; retained as a product-owned adoption constraint.
